components.name: Chart/Anomaly
components.description: Time series where a model flags outliers. Anomaly points use Chart/Data point State=Anomaly (dataviz/anomaly) and are explained by an AI insight line under the chart. Band shows the expected range the model learned (dataviz/uncertainty/95). Max 3 flagged points per view; each needs a reason in its tooltip. React: <AnomalyChart data anomalies expected? insight />
